C1_R1_SOURCING_WAS_WRONG_pull_is_NOT_wei.what_the_predeclaration_said: 'from the nominal's existing weights npz plus truth scalars'
C1_R1_SOURCING_WAS_WRONG_pull_is_NOT_wei.why_wrong: That npz carries exactly one per-row float array, weights_push. The quantity in the step-2 curvature W*pull/(1+pull)^2 is the step-2 CLASS-WEIGHT RATIO, i.e. r1, and omnifold.py:200 is weights_pull = weights_push * r1, so pull and push are different objects. The record keeps them as separate fields: at iteration 2, pull_mean_w_reco = 0.9676806416024684 against push_mean_w_reco = 1.0840529523260116.
C1_R1_SOURCING_WAS_WRONG_pull_is_NOT_wei.the_lane_s_bound_on_push_is_CORRECT_and_: f(w)=w/(1+w)^2 over the observed push range [0.367695, 8.012750] attains 0.196566 to 0.098643 with max 0.25 at w=1, so ANY ratio of column means of f on PUSH is bounded by 0.25/0.098643 = 2.5344. A 5-10x window is unreachable on push. Anyone running this statistic on push would read a null as physics.

C2_THE_63_CELL_BAND_IS_EFFECT_SELECTED_A.evidence: RECEIPT-20260815-cstat-tail-geometry-and-weighting-correction.json names the field `the_tail.n_cells_ratio_gt_1p5 = 63`, and carries `the_63` as a region key DISTINCT from `band_cols_10_15` (n = 84). So the 63 is selected by per-cell ratio > 1.5, not geometrically.
C2_THE_63_CELL_BAND_IS_EFFECT_SELECTED_A.why_it_matters: Any amplitude statistic computed on the 63 conditions on the dependent variable and is biased high by construction. f6006d1a listed values from the 63 alongside geometric ones without recording that one of them is post-selected.
there_are_FOUR_band_definitions_in_the_r: 70 = geometric columns 10-14, excluding the [15,20) zero crossing
C2_THE_63_CELL_BAND_IS_EFFECT_SELECTED_A.ruling_for_the_successor_reads: Use GEOMETRIC sets only. Band = columns 10-14 (70 cells); tail = columns 16-18 (45). Column 15 [15,20) is excluded deliberately: it is the zero crossing at ratio 1.005 and the receipt itself notes those cells dilute the band statistic. NEVER use the 63 for an amplitude correlation.

C3_R2_SIGN_CONVENTION_WAS_UNDECLARED_AND.the_defect: Band has nominal ABOVE family and tail BELOW, so log(member/nominal) has opposite sign in the two regions. A perfectly rank-1 family with one mode loading oppositely returns corr near -1 on SIGNED amplitudes, which fails CONFIRM (needs >= +0.5) and fails REFUTE (|corr| >= 0.2), landing UNRESOLVED for a convention reason rather than a physics one.
C3_R2_SIGN_CONVENTION_WAS_UNDECLARED_AND.adjudicated: MAGNITUDES. a_region(k) = sign(family-mean deviation in that region) * mean over that region's cells of log(member_k/nominal), with the sign fixed ONCE from the family and not per member. Report the raw signed corr and |corr| alongside so the convention is auditable.
